public_landscape_principles.title: Site zoning
public_landscape_principles.text: Use a balanced landscape split of softscape, hardscape, and utility areas. Allocate roughly 60% for planting, 25% for hardscape, and 15% for service and irrigation functions to create a practical and maintainable site layout.

public_landscape_principles.title: Circulation logic
public_landscape_principles.text: Keep pedestrian pathways direct, safe, and visually open. Avoid placing dense shrub masses in the main circulation path so accessibility and maintenance remain clean.

public_landscape_principles.title: Water management
public_landscape_principles.text: Use soil preparation, contouring, and micro-irrigation, so water is distributed efficiently. Plant high-water species near water access zones and low-water species in exposed, hot, or dry pockets.

public_landscape_principles.title: Climate adaptation
public_landscape_principles.text: Choose plant palettes according to local climate, sunlight exposure, soil, and seasonal variation. Tropical planting works best in warm humid and coastal zones, while drought-tolerant species suit exposed and dry sites.

site_planning_rules.title: Visual focality
site_planning_rules.text: Place specimen trees or water features at the central focal point, with low planting in front and taller canopy behind for depth and hierarchy.

site_planning_rules.title: Layered planting
site_planning_rules.text: Use canopy trees, accent shrubs, mid-height foliage, groundcover, and climbers in layered patterns to create a balanced landscape narrative.

site_planning_rules.title: Maintenance access
site_planning_rules.text: Leave maintenance zones and service access around irrigation controllers, valves, and plant beds so long-term upkeep remains manageable.

maintenance_guidelines.title: Soil preparation
maintenance_guidelines.text: Topsoil dressing with compost and manure improves root establishment. For turf and softscape, prepare a uniform and well-drained substrate before final plant placement.

maintenance_guidelines.title: Irrigation
maintenance_guidelines.text: Use drip irrigation and pressure-controlled units for planting beds; allow lawn zones to receive appropriate once or twice daily watering depending on heat index and season.

maintenance_guidelines.title: Seasonal upkeep
maintenance_guidelines.text: Prune lightly after the flowering window, inspect mulch depth and irrigation output, and replace seasonal annuals to keep the site visually sharp through the year.

quality_checks.title: BOQ quality
quality_checks.text: A good BOQ separates material, labor, irrigation, turfing, and contingency items so cost control stays transparent and auditable.

quality_checks.title: Execution quality
quality_checks.text: Execution should begin with site cleanup, soil treatment, drainage, hardscape edging, planting, turfing, and final commissioning.
